Good for beginners but not worth sticking with. If you’re just getting into ai character creation and chat bots then this app is great for learning how to write prompts and see how the ai works around it. The cheapish packages allow for unlimited chatting too which is good, though that does mean the ai has to take the hit for all that traffic. The ai is pretty tame and it allows for NSFW since it has no filter, so it’s fun to play around with and the stories are actually interesting and fun.

Now my criticisms. I don’t recommend you public any of your bots since you’ll find more issues than anything. If you want to create a bot that depicts extreme violence, any fetish, or something of that like, then either don’t make it public or don’t use this app. This isn’t good for any bots that may be from the Slenderman community or SCP community. The mods in the app and especially in the discord aren’t the most helpful either so don’t expect to get much feedback. The only two good ai models (imo) are paywalled so either energy for something worse or don’t use their app. Energy becomes a pretty number to look at too once you buy premium. I’ve been using the app for almost three years now and I have 41,000 energy saved up since there is no reason to use it at all.

Honestly, just don’t join the discord at all if you don’t know how to use their app because some of the mods there are disrespectful and will get an attitude with you immediately.

The app is fine for beginners and people who prefer to write SFW content since you’re less likely to have any issues. The energy system becomes redundant once you buy premium too, so either spend some money or you won’t be able to use the best ai models.
